_doc: Rules of the town builder (tools/city/, docs/protocolos/generar-ciudad.md). Offline only: the game reads the result (data/maps/<id>.json "decor"), never this file. Ids are scene ids of game/visuals/props/. Distances in tiles; curb/edge/wall = fraction of a tile the prop is pushed from its tile's centre towards the street, the plaza edge or the wall.
_decor_doc: Cosmetic dressing of the map made by tools/city/ciudad.py (vestir/generar), read only by WorldView (game/): the sim never reads it. kind house|yard|single: a filler lot (its tiles at..at+size); house: facing = the side of its door [dc, dr], flip = mirrored; lantern/prop/fence: one prop on tile `at`, off = pixel shift from the tile's centre. site: the item belongs to that map site (buildings of data/maps): a lot with site is the look of the site's footprint in a game without that building (drawn only then), a prop with site (a workshop's barrels) is drawn only with that building. Re-run the tool after editing rows or buildings.

filler._doc: Filler houses: one 3x3 lot per house, placed first where its front gives to a road within street_reach tiles; the door looks to that road: the look (as drawn, mirrored, its back view, back mirrored) is the one whose Door marker (data/building_sprites.json) is on that side. The houses, yards and the lone-tile prop come from data/view.json filler.

lanterns._doc: A lantern beside the street (grass or a yard, never a road, a door or its 8 neighbours) every `every` tiles (Manhattan, crossings first).

workshops._doc: Props by the door of each workshop type: against the wall beside the door when it is on a visible face, else on free tiles next to the door.

stalls._doc: A prop behind or beside each market stall (never on its service tile nor next to it).

plaza_benches._doc: Decorative benches on the edge of the plaza (backs to what borders it), at least `spacing` apart. The social points' benches (data/maps social_points) are drawn by the game apart from these.

generator._doc: tools/city/generator.py: houses = townsfolk houses at least (one per household of population_from's population, which the generated towns copy); town_reach = how far from the plaza's centre (tiles, the larger of the two axes) filler blocks go; max_filler = most filler blocks; fields = fields outside the town; tree_density = chance of a tree per free grass tile (x3 outside the town, x0.6 inside).

fences._doc: Fence segments on every edge of a field that faces something else (not water); a gate (gap) every gate_every road edges and on the trades' tiles.
